timecoded_text_to_speech.text: A Alliance for National Transformation is a young political party which was founded in
May 2019. Before it could go out to sell itself the populace who are struck by the COVID-19 pandemic.
But all the same, we had it to go into the general elections or 2021. However,
unprepared we were. And I'm happy to report that despite all the odds we have been able to secure
43 positions in the law of local government elections which are headed and represented by
Alliance for National Transformation. This party is a value based. It is a party which believes
in the Lenin government because as of now, although the constitution of the Republic of Uganda
has to place that a government should have 21 ministerial positions. We have a broad
position of one and eight ministers which therefore is a drain on the electoral sources that the
government has. We believe in respect for human rights which is an international and vocal
situation where every human being regardless of what he or she is should have his rights respected.
We believe in building institutions. Institutions like the three arms of government,
judiciary, legislature, executive, able to operate independently under the doctrine of separation of powers.
Alliance for National Transformation is a political party founded on values of justice,
of respect and dignity over human being. Zero tolerance, two corruption we believe that the
challenges that we are facing are a result of leaders that do not have integrity. Leaders that
have no values basically. So that is why values for us are very, very important. Respect the
culture of integrity in politics, integrity in deerings with other human beings. The
Alliance for National Transformation is so keen about to ensure that we create a nation that
believes in institutions of governance that separation of power becomes real and it's one thing
that we are creating in our systems as a political party. It's a culture that we want to
inculcate into the minds of the young and all the people of our country so that together we can
transform the body politic of our country. As leaders we have a lot to do as a party. We have a
lot to do. This party believes in reconciliation. We also strongly believe in family values. It is
only from the strong family values that you can have as table nation built. As I talk right now
Uganda is marked with the high levels of corruption and that is our point of departure to say we
want to have a country, a government run with feelings with the principles and the belief of zero
tolerance to corruption. We also strongly believe in the principle and the doctrine of equity.
Regardless of where a Ugandan is from we must have equity in terms of rendering of services
and provision of opportunities so that every person can be able to live and express his or her
abilities to the fullest.

youtube_description:
Meet representatives from the Alliance for National Transformation from #Uganda. #ANT is a people-centered, value-based political party that wants to improve the institutionalization of #political processes in Uganda.

In our new mini series, the ANT-representatives tell us about their motivations for founding the #party and their vision for the future of Uganda.
